message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Official)**  
*(Based on the official Uno® rulebook from Mattel)*  

---

### 1. Objective  
Be the first player to score **500 points**.  
Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round.

---

### 2. Components  
- 108 cards  
  - 25 × Red, 25 × Yellow, 25 × Green, 25 × Blue  
  - 4 × Wild, 4 × Wild Draw 4  
  - 2 × Draw 2, 2 × Skip, 2 × Reverse per color  

---

### 3. Setup  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Shuffle the deck. |
| 2 | Deal 7 cards to each player. |
| 3 | Place the remaining deck face‑down as the **draw pile**. |
| 4 | Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the **discard pile**. |
| 5 | If the first card is a special card (Draw 2, Skip, Reverse, Wild, or Wild Draw 4), follow the special‑card rules below. |

---

### 4. Gameplay  

| Turn | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | **Play a card** from your hand that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**. |
| 2 | If you cannot play, **draw one card** from the draw pile. |
| 3 | If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. |
| 4 | **Discard** the played card onto the discard pile. |
| 5 | If you have no cards left after discarding, you are **Uno**. Say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to say “UNO” when required results in a penalty (see below). |
| 6 | The next player continues. |

---

### 5. Special Cards  

| Card | Effect |
|------|--------|
| **Draw 2** | Next player draws two cards and loses their turn. |
| **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. |
| **Reverse** | Reverses the direction of play (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise). |
| **Wild** | Player chooses the new color to match. |
| **Wild Draw 4** | Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. **Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards.** |

> **Challenge Rule**  
> If a player believes the previous player illegally played a Wild Draw 4, they may challenge.  
> - If the challenger was correct, the challenger draws 4 cards.  
> - If the challenger was wrong, the original player draws 8 cards.  
> (Only available in the “Standard” version; optional in “House Rules.”)

---

### 6. Penalties  

| Situation | Penalty |
|-----------|---------|
| **Uno not declared** | Draw 2 cards. |
| **Illegal Wild Draw 4** | See Challenge Rule. |
| **Playing a card that does not match** | Draw 1 card. |

---

### 7. Winning a Round  

When a player discards their last card, the round ends.  
- Each opponent scores points equal to the value of the cards left in their hands:  
  - Number cards: face value (0–9)  
  - Draw 2, Skip, Reverse: 20 points each  
  - Wild, Wild Draw 4: 50 points each  
- The winner of the round receives those points.  
- The next round starts with the winner dealing the cards.

---

### 8. Scoring to 500 Points  

After each round, add the points earned to each player’s total.  
The first player to reach **≥ 500 points** wins the game.  
If a player reaches 500 mid‑round, the round still finishes so everyone gets points for that round.

---

### 9. Optional House Rules (Common Variations)

| Variation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw 2 or Wild Draw 4 cards instead of drawing. |
| **No Challenge** | Wild Draw 4 can be played at any time; no challenge rule. |
| **Draw‑4 as Wild** | Wild Draw 4 can be played even if the player has a matching color. |
| **Card‑Counting** | Keep track of cards left in the deck to anticipate draws. |
| **Team Play** | Two teams of two players each; teammates sit opposite each other. |

---

### 10. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet  

| Card | Match | Effect |
|------|-------|--------|
| **Number** | Same number or same color | None |
| **Draw 2** | Same symbol or same color | Next draws 2, skips turn |
| **Skip** | Same symbol or same color | Next skips turn |
| **Reverse** | Same symbol or same color | Reverse direction |
| **Wild** | Any | Choose new color |
| **Wild Draw 4** | Any | Choose new color; next draws 4, skips turn |

---

**Enjoy your game!**  
Feel free to tweak house rules to suit your group—Uno is all about fun and strategy.
